subject: PS3 Friends
author: callahan05
body:
All you have to due to add a friend on PS3 is to go to the friends icon on your PS3 crossbar menu, then using your D pad or Left stick navigate to the icon that says add friends and hit X it will bring up a message box type in the PS3 Is in the To: box and request to add a friend. or you can go into the players met menu and add a friend that way as well.
